purpose: Pins the structural-null model AND the excess-bias fire/no-fire rule for the `degenerate` (land_std < 3 m) flatness gate over the flat strata 2/5/7/17, BEFORE any number is computed. The run-model ticket (#65) imports this file and executes it blind; it does not define the model or thresholds inline. This is the #47-analog for the flatness-gate map: the confounded firing (a flatness gate biting flat strata is partly structural) cannot be talked to either verdict once the numbers are seen.
committed_before: Any per-stratum expected/observed number. This file is committed while #65 is still blocked. Any change to the model spec or a threshold here after #65 has produced a number must be a separate, dated commit that justifies itself.

seeded_by.e2_report_section: docs/research/e2-validation-report.md §5 — 'Three things Gate E has to weigh', point 3 (the confound) and the firing table
seeded_by.sibling_precedent: docs/adr/0006-accept-edm-flm-hollowing-stratum19.md — the edited×19 half of the same FAIL, reviewed → accept

the_firing.key: land_std < degenerate_land_std_m (= 3.0 m), applied in Phase C
the_firing.note: Strata 2/7/17 sit at 3.04-3.25x (barely over the old 3x line) and vanish under the sensitivity baseline; stratum 5 (5.32x) survives both baselines. The #54 guidance: 'centre on degenerate×5; carry 2/7/17 as lower-confidence.'

the_confound.why_this_file_exists: The gate keys on `land_std` (window flatness). `land_std` is NOT one of the six frozen metrics, but it correlates with two of them (`slope_mean`, `local_relief`). The k=20 strata are k-means cells in the six-metric space. So a flatness gate concentrating in the flat strata is PARTLY structural, not necessarily bias. Separating 'excess bias' from 'expected structure' needs an expected-ratio model the #54 verdict explicitly barred from being built post-hoc at Gate E. Building it, pre-registered, is what this map exists to do.
the_confound.the_capacity_trap: Any single expected-ratio model pre-loads a verdict. A saturated model of P(fire | six metrics) predicts each stratum's own average rate (within a k-means cell the six metrics are ~constant), so expected ≈ observed → excess ≈ 0 → always ACCEPT (vacuous). A too-rigid model (linear-in-logit) under-predicts the joint-low slope&relief corner where the flat strata live → manufactures fake excess → biases toward the expensive LOOSEN. The fire rule therefore does NOT pick one model: it requires the excess to survive an entire pre-registered capacity ladder, and reports two fixed anchors either side so a reader sees exactly where the analysis stood.
the_confound.scope_note: This file pins the RATE model only. The sibling question — is the dropped terrain junk or informative, and does the loss starve selection — is #64's job. The accept/loosen DECISION (#66) weighs this file's rate-signal against #64's representativeness/starvation findings. This file produces a signal, never the verdict.

committed_inputs.gated_catalog: data/catalog_gated (4386720 rows; keep 3052735; degenerate fires 428050, whole-catalog rate 0.0976)

model.name: stratum-blind expected-ratio model with a pre-registered capacity ladder

fit_population.rows: the 3,634,257 ASSIGNABLE catalog rows — every window whose six frozen metrics are non-NaN (so it z-scores and takes a stratum via centroids.json). Kept AND dropped windows are included; the model is over would-be (pre-gate) membership, exactly as E2.5 built its table.
fit_population.excluded: the 752,463 unassignable (NaN-metric) rows, of which ~24,853 are degenerate fires (~6% of degenerate). Excluding them is a stated limit on what this model can see, mirroring E2.5's 'built on 44% of drops' disclosure. It does not bias the flat-strata reading: degenerate's unassignable share is 6%, versus 83-92% for water/zero_fill.

features.use: the six frozen metrics ONLY, transformed exactly as k-means saw them: log on slope_mean & local_relief, then z-score via scaler.json params.

deliberately_excluded.land_std: the gate's own key. Including it lets the model predict the gate ~perfectly — circular; the residual would be ~0 by construction.
deliberately_excluded.stratum_id: stratum-blindness IS the test. The expected rate must come from the strata-DEFINING coordinates, not from stratum identity, or 'excess beyond structure' is undefined.

capacity_ladder.note: Every hyperparameter is pinned here so #65 has NO free knob to tune after seeing a number. All estimators are scikit-learn-native (the env that fit centroids.json, sklearn 1.9.0) so #65 needs no new dependency. Each model is fit to log-loss, so predicted probabilities are calibrated and the per-stratum expected rate = mean predicted P(fire) over the stratum's would-be members is the model-implied drop rate.

rungs.spec: main effects on the 6 z-scored metrics (6 coefficients + intercept), penalty='l2', C=1.0, solver='lbfgs', max_iter sufficient to converge
rungs.credits: first-order (monotone) trend only; under-predicts the joint-low corner

rungs.spec: same logistic settings on the degree-2 expansion of the 6 z-scored metrics (main + squares + pairwise interactions, incl. slope_mean×local_relief)
rungs.credits: the slope×relief flatness corner and simple curvature

rungs.spec: natural cubic B-splines, 5 knots per metric, main-effect splines only; same logistic settings

max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.1, max_iter=200 with early_stopping=True on a 10% internal validation split (log-loss), l2_regularization=0.0, random_state=0. Predictions produced by 5-FOLD CROSS-FITTING (KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=0)): each row's predicted P(fire) comes from a model trained on the other four folds.
rungs.credits: the structure-generous end — near-saturated but not memorising. Cross-fitting prevents the flexible model from memorising stratum-5's own members and inflating its expected rate, which would bias toward ACCEPT.

anchors.note: Reported for transparency, NEVER gated. They bracket the ladder.
anchors.A_uniform: expected rate = the flat-gate whole-catalog rate (0.0976) for every stratum — the ORIGINAL E2.5 null that fired 2/5/7/17. Credits zero structure.
anchors.A_saturated: expected rate = each stratum's own observed rate → residual 0 by definition. Credits all structure.

capacity_ladder.expected_rate_definition: for stratum h at rung r: mean over h's would-be members of that rung's predicted P(fire).

significance_null.form: Poisson-binomial null on the drop COUNT within a stratum, built from that rung's per-window predicted rates p_i. Under 'the gate fires independently at the model's predicted rates', the null count is PoissonBinomial({p_i}). Fire the statistical leg if the observed drop count exceeds the 99th percentile of this null.
significance_null.power_disclosure: At N ≈ 250k would-be members per flat stratum the Poisson-binomial is extremely tight, so this leg is trivially met by any real excess and is essentially non-binding at the debug tier. It is pinned for form, to guard the degenerate small-denominator case, and for Phase F re-use at smaller tiers where it gains teeth. The OPERATIVE constraints are the two residual-magnitude floors below, applied at every rung.

fire_rule.shape: two-tier. Stratum 5 is the primary test and the ONLY stratum that can trigger a LOOSEN rate-signal; strata 2/7/17 are computed identically and reported as lower-confidence corroboration, never independently triggering. This directly implements the #54 guidance.

primary_stratum_5.fires_LOOSEN_signal_iff: at EVERY ladder rung L0, L1, L2, L3, all three hold:
conditions: significance: observed drop count > 99th-pct Poisson-binomial null (per significance_null above)
primary_stratum_5.binding_rung: expected to be L3 (most structure credited → smallest residual). Requiring ALL rungs guards non-monotonicity and yields the full trajectory: if the residual decays to ~0 by L2 the signal is ACCEPT; if it is still large at L3 the signal is a robust LOOSEN.
primary_stratum_5.else: ACCEPT rate-signal (the flat-strata concentration is at or within structural expectation).

corroborating_strata_2_7_17.computed: the identical statistic and the same three-condition test, at every rung.
corroborating_strata_2_7_17.role: reported as context/corroboration only. May strengthen or qualify a stratum-5 firing and inform whether a fix (if #66 chooses LOOSEN) should be per-stratum or broader. Does NOT contribute to the LOOSEN/ACCEPT trigger.

number_provenance.10pp_absolute: reuses E2.5's '>= 10% of would-be membership' hollowing floor (docs/research/e2-gate-bar.json, E2.5 number_provenance: '10% is where hollowed is honestly the right word'), now applied to the RESIDUAL (excess beyond structural expectation) rather than the raw drop rate. A judgment call, not a derivation.
number_provenance.1.5x_relative: the E2.5 '3x' ratio analog, softened. E2.5's 3x was against a structure-free uniform baseline; here the denominator (expected_rate) already credits structure, so a smaller multiple is already meaningful. Conjunction with the absolute floor mirrors E2.5's shape and guards both failure modes (a pure ratio detonates on small denominators; a pure absolute misses a small stratum). A judgment call.
number_provenance.posture: Both floors, plus 'survives every rung with L3 binding', make LOOSEN deliberately hard to trigger. This matches the conservative pre-registration posture: ACCEPT is the legitimate default terminal verdict (#54 warned this firing 'may well be no-change'; ADR-0006 accepted the sibling), and LOOSEN commissions an expensive C→D→E re-run, so the excess must be undeniable and capacity-choice-proof.

knob.why: The plan §215-228 knob table has NO row for the land_std flatness screen (it lists caps: WBM water cap, EDM/FLM cap — the land_std and zero_fill PIXEL screens are absent). This file defines the knob's SHAPE so a LOOSEN outcome is well-formed; the numeric VALUE stays fog until the decision (#66).

shape.semantics: a window fires `degenerate` iff land_std < (per_stratum_override[stratum] if present else global). LOOSEN = lower the effective cap for the flagged strata (values = fog).

knob.why_this_shape: a superset: 'lower it globally' (edit only the scalar) and 'exempt/relax the flat families' (add overrides) both fall out as special cases, so this file does NOT pre-commit the execution map to either. The choice within the shape, and every value, is #66's.

proposed_knob_table_row.evidence: ADR-0002 §2 (near-constant tiles carry no MAE-learnable signal); none published — project
proposed_knob_table_row.amendment_trigger: this map's expected-ratio model (#63/#65) shows excess beyond structure on stratum 5 AND #64 shows the dropped terrain is informative and/or starves selection

blindness.discipline: #65 imports this file and computes the numbers; it does not redefine the model or thresholds. This file is committed while #65 is blocked, so no per-stratum number exists yet. The run-model ticket is blocked_by this ticket precisely so no one peeks first — the same discipline that made Gate E's own bar honest (#47).
blindness.reusable_at_scale: nothing here is a debug-tier constant: the population comes from the catalog, the strata from committed centroids, every threshold from this file. Phase F can re-run the identical spec against its own catalog and re-registered bar; the significance leg gains teeth at smaller N.
